items.title: Missing approver caused submission rejection
items.description: Documents without formal approver sign-off were rejected at review stage, requiring resubmission with 2-week delay.
items.recommendation: Always verify approver field is completed before submission.

items.title: Outdated standard references caused compliance failure
items.description: Referenced standards were superseded versions. Audit flagged non-compliance due to outdated references.
items.recommendation: Check all referenced standards are current and not superseded.

items.title: Version mismatch between TOC and content
items.description: Table of contents listed sections that were removed in a later revision, creating confusion during review.
items.recommendation: Regenerate TOC after any structural changes to the document.
